input: # groups (proto2): a field plus an implicit nested message; protoc lowercases the field name
# a group is also a legal oneof member
# extend: every member records the extendee it was declared under
syntax = "proto2";\nmessage M { extend E1 { optional int32 foo = 12; } }\n
# message extension/reserved ranges are half-open: `end` is EXCLUSIVE
syntax = "proto2";\nmessage M { extensions 2, 15, 9 to 11, 100 to max, 3; }\n
syntax = "proto2";\nmessage M { required int32 foo = 1; reserved 2, 15, 9 to 11, 3, 20 to max; }\n
# ... and `to max` reaches the full int32 space in a message_set_wire_format message
syntax = "proto2";\nmessage M { option message_set_wire_format = true; reserved 20 to max; }\n
syntax = "proto2";\nmessage M { extensions 4 to max; option message_set_wire_format = true; }\n
# a compound extensions statement puts its options on every range
syntax = "proto2";\nmessage M { extensions 2, 9 to 11 [(i) = 5]; }\n
# enum reserved ranges are CLOSED (end inclusive) and may be negative
# reserved names: every name in the list, not just the last
enum E { FOO = 0; reserved "foo", "bar"; }\n
syntax = "proto2";\nmessage M { reserved "foo", "bar", "foo bar"; }\n
# from edition 2023 reserved names may be bare identifiers
edition = "2023";\nenum E { FOO = 0; reserved foo, bar; }\n
# enum-level options and per-value options
# json_name and default are pseudo-options: protoc lifts them out of `options`
# an option name whose value text also occurs inside the name
# a multi-part option name, extension parts written in parens
# inf / nan option constants, negated or not
# proto3 explicit optional gets a synthetic `_<field>` oneof appended after the declared ones
syntax = "proto3";\nmessage M { optional int32 foo = 1; }\n
# ... and the synthetic name is X-prefixed until it stops colliding
# map entry name is CamelCase with underscores removed; `features` propagate to key/value
syntax = "proto3";\nmessage M { map<int32, string> primitive_type_map = 1; map<K, V> composite_type_map = 2; }\n
# a named type is left unresolved: typeName only, no `type` guess
syntax = "proto2";\nmessage M { enum NestedEnum {} optional NestedEnum e = 1; optional .a.b.C c = 2; }\n
# edition 2024: `import option` is its own dependency list
# edition 2024: export/local symbol visibility is recorded
# export/local stay usable as ordinary name components
# service- and rpc-level options
# an empty .proto is legal (and defaults to proto2)
